_note: PLACEHOLDER. A rule is ASSEMBLED from these, never bought whole: subject + (property comparator threshold) + action. So research reads 'you learned to reason about Self' or 'you learned to notice 30%', and every new component multiplies with everything you already know rather than adding one more canned line. Mirrors the writing system: literacy, not inventory. Components are granted by research nodes (research.json) or found in the wild.

components.name: Foe: any
components.blurb: Whichever enemy is nearest to hand.

components.name: Foe: lowest HP
components.blurb: Finish what's already hurt.

components.name: Foe: armour above
components.blurb: The first living foe whose current armour is strictly above the chosen Armour threshold.

components.name: Foe: highest HP
components.blurb: Go at the biggest thing in the room.

components.name: Ally: any
components.blurb: Anyone on your side, yourself included.

components.name: Ally: rank = back

components.name: Self

components.blurb: The first action after all skipped-turn recovery has been paid.

components.name: Foe: cannot reach me
